sql: SELECT id,actor_user_id,action,entity_type,entity_id,request_id,created_at,before_json->>'title' title,before_json->>'primary_media_id' prior_media_id,before_json->>'created_by' created_by,before_json->>'updated_by' updated_by,before_json->>'import_batch' import_batch,after_json->>'primary_media_id' after_media_id FROM audit_log WHERE (entity_type='artwork' AND action='delete') OR (entity_type IN('media_asset','media_assets','artwork_media')AND action='delete') OR (entity_type='artwork' AND action='update' AND before_json->>'primary_media_id' IS NOT NULL AND after_json->>'primary_media_id' IS NULL) ORDER BY created_at,id
